SC Delhi and East Bengal Reach Durand Cup Semi-finals

Sports Club Delhi defeated FC Raengdai 5-1 to advance to the Durand Cup semi-finals, where they will face East Bengal. East Bengal secured their semi-final spot by defeating the Indian Army, with Vishnu scoring the decisive goal. The Durand Cup is a football tournament featuring multiple teams.
